name: session-message-webui
description: Renders the canonical session message stream for humans: the Discord-style work chat at /sessions/:id, the raw log view at /sessions/:id/logs, the session list, in-chat commands, and Web Push delivery of new messages.
cardTemplate: Summarise the session-message-webui domain: chat and log routing, author_type-driven rendering, in-chat commands, per-client unread state, and Web Push subscription and delivery.
rationale: The chat screen, the log screen, the session list and Web Push all read the same canonical session_messages stream and change together whenever its presentation changes. They are separated from session-message-layer because that domain owns projection and storage, while this one owns how a human sees and is notified about the stream.
